title: Three Ways to Find Beauty Consumer Insights With Social Listening Data

facts.fact: Infegy analyzed nearly 4.85 million posts and articles about daily SPF use from 2020 through 2025.
facts.quote: We analyzed nearly 4.85 million posts and articles about daily SPF use from 2020 through 2025.

facts.fact: Infegy reports that overall positivity of online conversation about daily SPF use is 95%.
facts.quote: The conversation wasn’t just growing but overwhelmingly positive (95%) and layered with nuance.

facts.fact: Infegy's SPF report covers online discussions from January 1, 2020 to April 21, 2025, with overall positivity of 95%.
facts.quote: This report analyzes 4.85 million online discussions about daily SPF use from January 1, 2020, to April 21, 2025. Overall positivity is 95%.

facts.fact: Infegy's analysis of year-round SPF mentions found consistent growth throughout the year, including in winter, per Infegy Starscape.
facts.quote: we found consistent growth throughout the year, even in winter.

facts.fact: Infegy's SPF post volume chart covers January 2020 through February 28, 2025 using the Infegy Social Dataset.
facts.quote: Post Volume Pertaining to Year-Round SPF Usage (January 2020 through February 28, 2025); Infegy Social Dataset.

facts.fact: Infegy reports GRWM (Get Ready With Me) video content exploded in early 2023 across TikTok and Instagram, after which engagement and post volume declined as content shifted toward lifestyle storytelling.
facts.quote: These exploded in early 2023, gaining traction across platforms like TikTok and Instagram.

facts.fact: Infegy's GRWM post-volume chart covers February 2020 through January 2025 using the Infegy Social Dataset.
facts.quote: Declining GRWM post volume (February 2020 through January 2025): Infegy Social Dataset.

facts.fact: Infegy's report on everyday SPF analyzed 4.846 million sunscreen-related social profiles, of which 86% were positive.
facts.quote: The report analyzes 4.846M sunscreen-related social profiles (86% positive).

facts.fact: In Infegy's everyday SPF persona analysis, the 'Beauty & Lifestyle Influencers' persona comprised 727K profiles, or 15%.
In Infegy's everyday SPF persona analysis, the 'Skincare Enthusiasts' persona comprised 485K profiles, or 10%.
In Infegy's everyday SPF persona analysis, the 'Skincare & Medical Professionals' persona comprised 194K profiles, or 4%.
Infegy's Figure 5 persona data for everyday SPF covers social conversation from January 1, 2020 through April 21, 2025, drawn from the Infegy Social Dataset.
facts.quote: Key Personas About Everyday SPF (January 1, 2020 through April 21, 2025); Infegy Social Dataset.

facts.fact: Infegy's Figure 4 narrative clustering for everyday SPF covers online discussions from January 2020 through April 2025.
facts.quote: Underlying Narrative Clusters About Everyday SPF (January 2020 through April 2025); Infegy Social Dataset.
